_comment: Structured to mirror a Workday application flow. Fields marked FILL_ME need your input. The agent reads this file to auto-fill applications, and appends new answers here whenever a form asks something not yet covered (see custom_answers).

resumes._comment: Maps each of your 4 resumes. The agent picks one per job based on role (ai vs ml/ds) and location (bengaluru vs other).

addresses._comment: Location-dependent, like the resume. Use 'bengaluru' for Bengaluru/Bangalore jobs, 'other' for everything else.

bengaluru.address_line_1: Orchid PG, Feb 30 Layout, 4th Cross Rd

work_experience.description: Built Prescriber Lens, a six-agent LangGraph NL2SQL pipeline converting pharma sales queries into validated BigQuery SQL (intent understanding, schema discovery, ChromaDB few-shot retrieval, SQL generation, SQLGlot validation, human approval); reduced manual query effort by 60% with 85%+ accuracy. Built an LLM evaluation and observability layer. Designed campaign ROI measurement pipelines (Propensity Score Matching, ANCOVA) on large-scale HCP prescription data in BigQuery and R.

Fine-tuned Japanese LLMs for short-text transaction classification and shipped production inference APIs adopted by 5 Rakuten business units. Performed domain-adaptive continued pretraining (DAPT) of RoBERTa on merchant/financial corpora, improving merchant name classification accuracy from 88.05% to 91.35%.

voluntary_disclosures._comment: Mostly asked by US employers. Set to 'Decline to self-identify' if you prefer not to answer.
voluntary_disclosures.veteran_status: I am not a protected veteran

custom_answers._comment: Reusable answers to free-text application questions. When a form asks something new, the agent asks you and saves the answer here so it is reused next time.
